title: Lee Collins arrives in New Orleans
summary: Lee Collins is said to be powerful; Alexis recalls his stopping at a hotel and calling, when Alexis was alone after his wife and mother died.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: We were talking about Lee Collins. You said he was powerful.
Yes, when Lee came here, he stopped at this hotel on Belmont Street, and he called up his house. My wife and my mother got killed in my car. I was living here alone.
